concerns.text: The primary predictor `thread_type` (Prime vs Control) is defined as a regex match on the Reddit thread **title**, but the chosen dataset `fddemarco/pushshift-reddit-comments` does **not contain the `title` field** (see the “Missing Thread Title” note in the plan). Consequently FR‑001 cannot be satisfied and the Linear Mixed Model that tests the priming hypothesis (`prosocial_intent_score ~ thread_type + …`) has no valid independent variable. The plan’s fallback “temporary redesign” that drops the priming classification would eliminate the very effect the study is meant to evaluate, making the research question untestable with the current data. This is a methodological/scientific flaw, not a mere implementation detail.
